## Procedures and ports

Positions are in the torso frame: meters from the umbilicus, +x the participant's left, +y out of the abdomen, +z toward the head. Children scale by `case.bodyScale`.

### Laparoscopic cholecystectomy (`lap_cholecystectomy`)

13 steps, about 60 minutes. Must read clearly up close: `anat_gallbladder`, `anat_cystic_duct`, `anat_cystic_artery`, `anat_common_bile_duct`.

| Port | Label | Size | Torso position (x, y, z) m |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `umbilical` | Umbilical camera port | 12 mm | (0.00, 0.00, 0.00) |
| `epigastric` | Epigastric operating port | 12 mm | (-0.02, 0.01, 0.16) |
| `right_mcl` | Right midclavicular port | 5 mm | (-0.07, 0.00, 0.11) |
| `right_aal` | Right anterior axillary port | 5 mm | (-0.13, -0.02, 0.07) |

### Laparoscopic appendectomy (`lap_appendectomy`)

10 steps, about 45 minutes. Must read clearly up close: `anat_appendix`, `anat_mesoappendix`, `anat_appendicular_artery`, `anat_cecum`.

| Port | Label | Size | Torso position (x, y, z) m |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `umbilical` | Umbilical camera port | 12 mm | (0.00, 0.00, 0.00) |
| `left_lower` | Left lower quadrant port | 5 mm | (0.07, 0.00, -0.08) |
| `suprapubic` | Suprapubic port | 5 mm | (0.00, 0.00, -0.13) |

12 steps, about 180 minutes. Must read clearly up close: `anat_sigmoid_colon`, `anat_inferior_mesenteric_artery`, `anat_left_ureter`, `anat_rectum`.

| Port | Label | Size | Torso position (x, y, z) m |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `umbilical` | Umbilical camera port | 12 mm | (0.00, 0.00, 0.00) |
| `right_lower` | Right lower quadrant port | 12 mm | (-0.08, 0.00, -0.07) |
| `right_upper` | Right upper quadrant port | 5 mm | (-0.08, 0.00, 0.06) |
| `left_lower` | Left lower quadrant port | 5 mm | (0.08, 0.00, -0.07) |
